subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should the operator-facing ingress inspect/drain/ack verb and reconnect age-threshold behavior be included before this issue closes, tracked separately after the durable replay fix, or rejected as outside the current recovery model?
rationale: The remaining bug has an implementation candidate, but the extra recovery tooling asks change operator UX and durable-ingress policy beyond the narrow replay fix.

options.title: Land bounded replay first
options.body: Treat the open durable replay PR as the required fix for this issue and track operator drain/ack tooling separately only if maintainers want that workflow.

options.title: Require recovery tooling
options.body: Keep this issue open after bounded replay lands until supported queue inspection or drain/ack recovery exists.

options.title: Reject extra operator surface
options.body: Close the tooling portion as not planned once bounded replay lands, leaving no new CLI recovery verb from this report.

recommendation.title: Land bounded replay first
recommendation.body: Treat the open durable replay PR as the required fix for this issue and track operator drain/ack tooling separately only if maintainers want that workflow.
